# Delivery Platform

**System**

Lets customers order food, restaurants prepare it and couriers deliver it.

**A software system** is the biggest thing you draw inside your organisation: something that does a job for people and that one team can own.

This is the system the example looks inside: its containers are in view 3, and the components of one container in view 4.

## Contains

- [Courier App](courier-app.md) (container) – Shows couriers their jobs and the way there.
- [Customer App](customer-app.md) (container) – Lets customers browse menus, order and track their food.
- [Dispatch Worker](dispatch-worker.md) (container) – Finds a nearby courier for every order that's ready.
- [Order API](order-api.md) (container) – Takes orders, charges for them and tracks their progress.
- [Order Events](order-events.md) (container) – Carries events like order-placed and order-ready.
- [Orders Database](orders-db.md) (container) – Stores orders, menus and deliveries.
- [Restaurant Portal](restaurant-portal.md) (container) – Lets restaurants manage menus and incoming orders.
